captions: 6:02 a.m. Gate B12. A new city. A new job.
Your mother's voice note: “Did you say the travel du'a?”
You didn't. Soon, 6,000 km from her. And you're scared.
The prayer room by Gate B9. Cold water on your wrists.
Two rak'ahs. Then you tell Him. The job. The fear. Her.
Boarding. Phone in your pocket. Heart, finally, quiet.

post.caption:
200 views on your goodbye post. Not one du'a for the road. 🤍

We tell everyone we're leaving. We forget to tell the One who goes with us.

“Indeed I am near. I respond to the invocation of the supplicant when he calls upon Me.” (2:186)

This morning, before you leave the house: tell Him first.
